# Set-ZbxTemplateGroup

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a template group.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxTemplateGroup [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplateGroup>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-Uuid <string>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A template group is a named set of templates; permissions select templates by their groups. The Set-ZbxTemplateGroup cmdlet changes the template groups given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with templategroup.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every template group the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed template groups back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a template group

```powershell
Set-ZbxTemplateGroup -InputObject 'Templates/Databases' -Name 'Templates/Database servers'
```

Renames the template group Templates/Databases to Templates/Database servers.

### Example 2: Change a template group and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxTemplateGroup -InputObject 'Templates/Databases' -Name 'Templates/Database servers' -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the template group Templates/Databases back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplateGroup>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
